title: ‘She’s One of Us’: Mary Peltola’s Bumpy Rise to Political Power
summary: Ms. Peltola, the Democratic Senate candidate in Alaska, has complicated politics: She is pro-gun, pro-oil and pro-gas — but also pro-environment and especially pro-fish.
